title: Big Paydays Ahead for Anthropic's Early Backers
text: Anthropic’s upcoming public listing is poised to create multibillion-dollar gains for top venture capital firms, tech companies and independent investors that have backed the company. Bloomberg’s Natasha Mascarenhas explains why many of the investors raking in huge paydays won’t have their stakes listed when Anthropic releases its IPO filings. She joins Ed Ludlow on “Bloomberg Tech.” (Source: Bloomberg)
